backup.production_rule: s104 (Lloyd 2026-10-31: close every remaining meter-check gap). admin_report_blocks_v1 lists, besides the unresolved photo mismatches, any unresolved reading whose vision_raw.photo_date_lines (written by verify-meter-photo, s103) is a non-empty array, with reason (mismatch | photo_date), photo_date_lines text[] and photo_archived (a photo path on file whose storage object in bucket cleaning-photos is gone); the 15 existing columns keep their order and the three new ones are at the end (drop + create, re-granted authenticated only). admin_resolve_report_block_v1 also answers such a photo-date finding (both actions), answers a missing id with the same 42501 'inspect_cleaning denied' as a refusal, and re-points the NEXT reading by (stay date, recorded_at, id) so a later reading of the same checkout day is not skipped. meter_settle_estimates_v1 counts an answered mismatch as B only when vision_resolved_by is a staff user whose role may inspect_cleaning (a cleaner who typed the admin sentence through resolve_meter_followup_v1 no longer makes B). system_tasks_sweep_v1 also closes open meter_estimate_settled tasks older than 3 days and skips a pattern-matching but impossible date silently; it returns the extra key info. get_meter_photo_followups gains checkout_date and guest_name at the end (drop + create, re-granted authenticated and service_role). Each replaced function is guarded on its live md5 (or this release's own) with errcode 55000. Live md5s read 2026-10-31 (md5 of replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')): admin_report_blocks_v1 e1093804346d7488d3c2b617ceae2205, admin_resolve_report_block_v1 f23647ef6a039daf1999faf9c33e35fd, get_meter_photo_followups 05c12c435acd72f5f1f04e6f657f0b66, meter_settle_estimates_v1 36726d52dccd5911ac473f607f4aab06, system_tasks_sweep_v1 e92e15b99917ab19cd8c9bf3c6510b44.
backup.notes: Phase expand: five functions replaced, no table, column, trigger or cron change. Old apps keep working: the admin dashboard reads the new fields as optional, Cascade Staff falls back to 'Report sent <date>' when checkout_date is absent. Order: SQL first, then the admin dashboard and Cascade Staff builds. The sweep returns an extra jsonb key (info); nothing reads its result but the cron job. Earlier tests changed for the new behaviour: s101_report_blocks.sql (unknown id is now 42501) and s102_task_sweep.sql (the answered B needs a staff resolver; the sweep result has info).
